domain: B2B CRM / SaaS Dashboard for Spice Factory (Gewürzberg GmbH)
design_philosophy: Modernize the legacy orange-gradient design into a premium, enterprise-grade B2B CRM. Leverage 'Control Room' grids, high-density data layouts, and strict functional typography. Replace generic gradients with stark contrasts and a mature 'Deep Rust' accent to nod to the spice factory heritage (Gewürzberg) while maintaining extreme professional clarity.

rules: No generic full-screen gradients. Color is for function only.
Tint neutral greys with cool/zinc tones to feel industrial and crisp.
Primary color (Deep Rust) used exclusively for CTAs, active states, and key data highlights.

headings.usage: Authoritative, tight letter-spacing (tracking-tight) for dashboard headers and modal titles. Never use Inter.

body.usage: Data-dense tables, lists, and forms. Legible at small sizes.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: MODE B (The 'Control Room' Grid) for Dashboards.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Dense and compact for data, but generous for structural padding. Use p-6 or p-8 for main cards. gap-4 or gap-6 for grids.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: Subtle roundness. max 8px (rounded-md). No pill-shaped buttons unless explicitly requested.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align dense content and tables.

surface_styles.dashboard_cards: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Flat background (bg-white), 1px subtle border (border-zinc-200), no drop shadow by default.
surface_styles.interactive_cards: Hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-0.5) and subtle shadow (shadow-md).
surface_styles.headers: Solid background with a hard bottom border. If scrolling content goes under, use Crystal Glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-zinc-200/50).

components.tables: Dense rows, left-aligned, muted text for secondary data, stick to 'IBM Plex Sans' for tabular numbers.
components.buttons: Flat, sharp edges (rounded-md), solid Deep Rust for primary, outline/ghost for secondary. Always define hover state explicitly (hover:bg-[#8C3118] hover:text-white).
components.forms: Use standard Shadcn inputs. No floating labels. Clear, bold label text above inputs. 1px border on inputs, subtle ring on focus (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#BA4323]/20 focus:border-[#BA4323]).
components.icons: Phosphor Icons for dense dashboards (clean, legible at small sizes). Install via: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react

image_urls.description: Truck on highway. Use for the Route Planner or Shipments section background/hero if needed.
Professional portrait for current user or contact profiles.
Professional portrait for lead or customer profiles.
Professional portrait for lead or customer profiles.

rules: Never use placeholder image URLs like via.placeholder.com. Use only the provided Unsplash URLs.
Use Lucide-react (if pre-installed) or Phosphor Icons for UI adornments.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must change state visually. Contrast must be maintained.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific properties: 'transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out' or 'transition-transform'.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case and role-based (e.g., data-testid='submit-order-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject the font CDN links (Fontshare for Cabinet Grotesk, Google Fonts for IBM Plex Sans) into the index.html or global layout.
Update tailwind.config.js to include the custom font families and the custom colors (especially the 'Deep Rust' primary #BA4323).
Implement the 'Control Room' grid layout for the CRM dashboard screens.
Avoid using Shadcn 'Card' components where pure HTML/Tailwind achieves a better flat, grid-border look, but use Shadcn for complex logic (Tables, Dialogs, Selects, Calendars).
Remove all legacy orange/amber gradients. Replace with the specified #BA4323 (Deep Rust) primary color for specific call-to-actions, maintaining a high-contrast black/white/grey dominant UI.
Apply `Cabinet Grotesk` font family to all headings. Apply `IBM Plex Sans` for body.
Ensure the AI Lead Finder and Maps use the minimalist, data-dense styling defined in Archetype 4.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, and major interaction points have explicit data-testids.
